text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — finalizing speaker slate + live demo flow for the Apr 12 webinar. Need run-of-show, speaker script owners, rehearsal times. Proposed: 30m total, 12m product+context, 10m live demo, 6m Q&A, 2m close. Who can make a 1hr rehearsal Mon/Tue?

Omar (Events): I can book the Zoom room + backstage channel. Who needs presenter access? @Rohan will you own the demo infra? Also need staging API keys and a dedicated demo VM.

Rohan (Eng): I’ll own the demo stack. Plan: stable model snapshot (v2026-04-01), plus a cached fallback that returns a prerecorded response if live fails. Will prep a prewarm step to avoid cold starts.

Tess (Product): I’ll own slides and the 12m product intro. Can we keep slide count <= 16 and add speaker notes with exact lines? Also want 2 fallback screenshots in case the demo dies.

Lina (Sales): Sales ask — add a lead tag when an attendee asks about pricing/SLAs. Route those to AE queue "MMR-MidMarket" and cc the webinar AE. Also add a short demo CTA slide with a calendar link.

Maya (Marketing): Rehearsal plan suggestion:
- Tech check (10m): confirm presenter rights + audio/video + shared deck in Zoom.
- Dry run (30m): full flow with slides, demo, and transitions.
- Q&A drill (10m): practice rapid answer handoffs.
Times: Mon Apr 10 16:00 or Tue Apr 11 11:00. Reply with availability. :thumbsup: Mon, :raised_hands: Tue

Omar (Events): Booked tentative Zoom + backstage for both slots. I'll lock one when majority picks. Also will create a slack backstage channel and add ops-bot + deploy-bot.

Rohan (Eng): Staging details:
```
STAGING_DEMO_ENDPOINT=https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/demo
HEADERS: X-API-KEY: DEMO-READONLY-12345
Prewarm script:
curl -s -X POST $STAGING_DEMO_ENDPOINT -H "X-API-KEY: DEMO-READONLY-12345" -d '{"prompt":"prewarm"}'
```
I'll run the prewarm 5m before start and have a cached JSON response at /demo-fallback.json

Tess (Product): For transitions — callouts on slides:
- Slide 8: "Live demo starts" -> handoff to Rohan, 3 bullets for expectations
- Slide 14: "Q&A" -> hand back to Maya for wrap and CTA
Can someone add timestamps to the speaker notes?

Lina (Sales): For lead routing, please add a short hidden field in registration: "Interest: pricing / pilot / technical" so we can prioritize routing. Also confirm we'll have a post-webinar survey with an interest checkbox.

Maya (Marketing): Agreed. Action items:
- Rohan: demo infra + prewarm + fallback JSON (due Apr 8).
- Tess: slide deck + annotated notes + screenshots (due Apr 9).
- Omar: Zoom + backstage + presenter invites (due Apr 9).
- Lina: lead routing fields + calendar CTA + post-survey (due Apr 9).
- Ops-bot / deploy-bot: reminder triggers 24h and 1h before rehearsals.

Rohan (Eng): Confirming deadlines. I'll post the smoke-test logs in the backstage channel and upload a short clip of the demo in case we need quick sharing.

Omar (Events): Backstage channel created: #webinar-apr12-backstage. Invited everyone. I’ll post rehearsal links + a short runbook that lists failover steps.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Final question — fallback narrative if demo fails live: short script to pivot to screenshots + prerecorded clip and call to action to book a pilot. Can someone draft 2 lines for the host to read?

Tess (Product): Draft for host: "We had a hiccup with the live demo — we’ll switch to a quick recorded walkthrough to make sure you see the full flow. If you want a live session after the webinar, book a pilot with our team via the CTA."

Lina (Sales): Add: "If you’re interested in piloting or benchmarking, fill the quick interest form — we’ll prioritize outreach within 48 hours."

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll stitch those into the notes and drop the final run-of-show doc in the backstage channel by EOD. Rehearsal votes: Mon: Maya, Omar, Tess; Tue: Rohan, Lina. Omar — please pick Mon or Tue based on majority and lock time.

Omar (Events): Locking Mon Apr 10 16:00. Calendar invites sent. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal-1: 2026-04-09T16:00:00Z (24h), rehearsal-2: 2026-04-10T15:00:00Z (1h)

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — will post final run-of-show and assign slide owners in the PM.
